findings.title: Joined formation sustained by nourishment

findings.reader_payoff: The paired benefits become intelligible as support that lets a dependent collective take shape and remain joined.
findings.containment: This is a contextual resonance around the ordinary feeding claim. It does not replace food or assert that the surface verb lexically means grafting in this clause.

epistemic.reason: The branch nominations and supports are trusted, while the contextual synthesis remains a review-level inference.
